storySections.title: Basic Information
storySections.content:
She is the flag that flutters high as the ship sails, guiding its course; she is also the dirge that holds to its duty until the very last moment, when the ship sinks beneath the waves.

Her responsibility, her duty, her life—all are bound to the ship; nothing else remains.

For guiding the course is the very meaning of her existence.

storySections.title: Story: I
storySections.content:
No one knows where that ghost ship lies, nor can anyone confirm whether "it" truly exists. The only clue I have is that ivory head sculpture, which seems to possess some sort of strange magic.

Ever since I came into possession of it, I have had the same dream every night—yes, the dream of that ghost ship, drifting somewhere unknown. Its hull burns with a glimmer that writhes like a living thing, as though opening a gateway to dimensions beyond mortal reach. Upon waking, I can still recall those blasphemous, pathological whispers.

How I wish I were mad, or that I could forget those bizarre sounds—sounds that no human throat could ever produce. But I cannot.

That cursed dream, that cursed flicker of intellect, torment me without rest. And so I must find "it," led by the ivory sculpture. Frtunately, the professors from Miskatonic will walk this road with me, and together we shall seek out the ghost ship and the St. Elmo's Fire—that is what they call the writhing glimmer.

Wish me luck. May the Lord watch over us.

—Excerpt from <Italic:Miskatonic Supernatural Phenomena Investigation Archives>

storySections.title: Story: II
storySections.content:
Corposant's daily schedule is very fixed; you just need to be at a specific place at a specific time to find her.

Generally speaking, Corposant gets up at 6:00, takes a cold bath, and does exercises. 7:00 is breakfast time, and besides oatmeal and pickled fish, a large amount of caffeine supplements is also required.

From 9:00 to 12:00, it is Corposant's study time; she will revise nautical charts or calibrate equipment during this period. When the class bell rings, Corposant will come outdoors, waving a flag as a traffic officer, which greatly alleviates the road congestion during lunch.

Corposant's lunch time depends on the "traffic conditions, " but no later than 12: 30. After a short break, at 14:00, Corposant will appear at the seaside on time, observing wind direction and weather. At this point, attention should be paid to the movements of Corposant, Faros, and Celeste, to avoid them "commandeering" the museum model ships or luring passersby out to sea.

Dinner time is at 19:00. To numb her sleep cycle, completely destroyed by long-term sailing, Corposant needs to consume a large amount of alcohol and sleep-inducing tinctures. Only in this way can she successfully fall asleep at 22:00; otherwise, she will force herself to stay awake to deal with possible "accidents" during the voyage.

Consequently, situations resulting from this include, but are not limited to, the phenomenon of St. Elmo's fire going out of control, leading to the entire area shining like daylight, or abnormal, uncontrolled area voltage, machinery running erratically, fires, etc.

<Red:Note, during this time absolutely do not let Erica and Corposant come into contact with each other!>

Finally, a criticism notification:

After Corposant's arrival, Winkle made several attempts to extract and study @2 at Corposant's chest as a light source. A verbal criticism has been issued; if any abnormalities are found, be sure to inform the Keeper in time.

—Keeper %player%

storySections.title: Story: III
storySections.content:
Before learning to speak, having grown up on a cruise ship, Corposant could already mimic the rhythm of waves crashing against the ship.

Sometimes the rhythm was "splash, " sometimes it was "boom, " like a lullaby sung by nature, making her feel secure, making her feel familiar, making her yearn.

She always understood the "mood" of the sea quicker than others, always read the "language" of the clouds quicker than others, and everyone said she was a natural "navigator."

In reality, when she first heard the term, young Corposant couldn't understand. She only instinctively wanted to help the captain and sailors who took her in, wanting them to return home safely, not to be lost to storms or disasters from other ships.

The navigator who understood her wish said, "Become a navigator, Corposant, become a navigator, fulfill your duty, and then your wish will come true."

The naive Corposant nodded, and thus, that navigator became her mentor. He taught her how to observe the stars, how to calibrate the sextant, and told her the ballads passed down through generations of navigators, those ominous ballads.

"I don't want to be embraced by saltwater, that's too cold, nor do I want to become phosphorescence." Young Corposant objected.

Her mentor didn't teach her anything further, just touched her head and smiled.

Because time will teach her the meaning of the "navigator's" duty—

She is the sole guide on the vast ocean, the only hope.

storySections.title: Story: IV
storySections.content:
Until the last moment, Corposant was diligently fulfilling her duties, yet the ship she piloted still sank.

Every night, she dreams of those lost passengers: water flooding into the cabins, sea monsters' Tentacles rampaging, people drowning, jumping overboard, kneeling for one last guidance, but hope was lost.

This brutal reality reproaches her, tortures her—she has desecrated her profession.

For this, she must be punished, and the lightning that eternally entwines and torments her is the retribution. But it's not enough; she must atone for her negligence.

Fortunately, the great entity provided the answer: when the Divine Realm descends, the world will become paradise.

"So, to quell the eternal roaring of the sea, for the innocent buried at sea, for guiding the direction of all beings, I request the Divine Realm's arrival."

This is her last, final navigation.

daily.title: Awaken
daily.content: The navigator Corposant reports for duty! The flag has been prepared, personal condition is good, please give the launch order, Keeper.

daily.title: Upgrade: I
daily.content: I am merely fulfilling my duty as navigator and require neither report nor praise.

daily.title: Upgrade: II
daily.content: Rest assured, I shall use this power to guide the ship safely, and I will never misuse it.

daily.title: Upgrade: III
daily.content: I firmly believe in the fundamental law that effort brings reward, and I shall work even harder in future.

daily.title: Enlighten: Observe
daily.content: The ritual to deepen spiritual connection carries risks and unknown results. But rest assured, I will navigate for you to ensure the ritual is completed smoothly.

daily.title: Enlighten: Ponder
daily.content: I feel... a sense of weightlessness, followed by violent shaking—as if the ship were being tossed about. Keeper, follow my movements to find your centre and stay balanced.

daily.title: Enlighten: Reflect
daily.content: This dizzying sensation is much like seasickness. Please close your eyes, take my hand, and lean against me. That should ease it a little.

daily.title: Enlighten: Insight
daily.content: An unexpected incident occurred during the ritual. Forgive me for striking your arm with the flag; I had to keep you conscious.

daily.title: Enlighten: Elevate
daily.content: The spiritual link has been established. I can sense your presence. This is my first time navigating the void. If anything drifts off course, please correct me at once.

daily.title: Enlighten: Florish
daily.content: The ritual is complete. Thank you for your cooperation. Next time, I'll prepare special flags to guide us more safely through it.

daily.title: Affinity: I
daily.content: As long as you are in need, Corposant is always on standby.

daily.title: Affinity: II
daily.content: Some people are like steamships—slow to respond, but capable of high speed. Others, diesel ships—quick to start, but with limited power. So what about you, Keeper?

daily.title: Affinity: III
daily.content: Forgive me. I understand ships better than people. But if I may: your keel is neither wood nor iron, but steel. Strong. Steadfast. Truly admirable.

daily.title: Affinity: IV
daily.content: You've proven self on multiple occassions. I believe you're an excellent navigator, perhaps more capable than I am.

daily.title: Affinity: V
daily.content: On our next voyage, I'd like to board the ship as something other than navigator. Uh... I mean, as one who follows your lead. You have my complete trust, Keeper.

daily.title: Chat: Touch
daily.content: Is my hat askew? Apologies, but I'm not sure what you mean. Please give me clear instructions.

daily.title: Chat: About the Crisis
daily.content: I don't know why it exists. I know only this: I must navigate successfully, and bring everyone home.

daily.title: Chat: About Mythag
daily.content: Here, I encounter many kinds of ships and work with advanced navigation equipment. I find it deeply rewarding. Above all, I believe this "ship" is charting the right course for human history.

daily.title: Chat: What I Like
daily.content: Rather than "like, " I prefer the word "devotion." When I look directly at that indescribable god, my mind loses reason and fills with ecstasy. I should fear Him, but I can't help myself.

daily.title: Chat: What I Hate
daily.content: Without order, what remains in this world? Only chaos.

daily.title: Chat: About the Keeper
daily.content: You have my full respect. I vow to carry out every order you give.

daily.title: Chat: About Celeste
daily.content: When necessary, a navigator trained in engine room cooperation can act as helmsman. But for the ship's safety, I still prefer to entrust that task to someone more skilled.

daily.title: Chat: About Faros
daily.content: The lighthouse system eases the demands of navigation. Its beam is strong and clear. I'm glad to sail with Faros.

daily.title: Chat: About Her Flag
daily.content: The flag is the navigator's language, and also their epitaph. When the ship sinks, salvagers will read the last message I left from the wreckage of the flag.

battle.title: Investigation Begins
battle.content: Cirrus clouds observed, with a continued drop in barometric pressure. All hands alert. The ship is about to enter a storm.

battle.title: Investigation Success
battle.content: These experiences are invaluable. I will record them in detail in the logbook, for future sailors.

battle.title: Investigation Halted
battle.content: This chaos is the result of my miscalculation of the route. I am willing to accept punishment in accordance with the rules.

battle.title: Defense: I
battle.content: Assessing the ship's trim and balance.

battle.title: Hit: I
battle.content: I will not be defeated by this storm.

battle.title: Hit: II
battle.content: Ensure the ship's safety above all else.

battle.title: Skill: I
battle.content: Measuring the altitude angle of celestial bodies.

battle.title: Special Skill: I
battle.content: Begin updating the nautical chart with corrections.

battle.title: Rouse
battle.content: I will lead my ship to the correct course.

battle.title: Exalt
battle.content: Lower the foremast sails. Waves are pressing against the port side. Helmsman, adjust course per my calculations.

battle.title: Over-Exalt
battle.content: Sailors, follow my guidance. I will make sure we reach the harbour safely.
